g.text: Individual and binned working Pearson residuals
Residual and zero-mass panels combine concurrent activity memberships back to one 1/k-weighted participant-hour.
The autocorrelation panel retains activity-specific boundary-aware runs; concurrent rows never become lag neighbours.
All panels are descriptive model checks; the temporal curves remain exploratory pointwise summaries.
